products.title: BabySkin
products.description: This gentle yet effective cleanser thoroughly removes impurities, excess oils, and makeup without stripping the skin’s essential moisture barrier. Unlike traditional cleansers that can cause dryness and irritation, this formula cleanses deeply while preserving the skin’s natural hydration, preventing that tight, dry feeling after use. It is ideal for all skin types, including sensitive skin, as it helps balance moisture levels for a healthy, hydrated complexion. Infused with nourishing ingredients, this cleanser supports long-term skin health by protecting the skin’s natural oils and barrier. Regular use ensures smooth, refreshed skin that feels comfortable and well-hydrated, free from dryness or irritation. It is an essential step in your routine, keeping your skin clean, nourished, and protected from environmental stressors.

products.description: This advanced formula regulates sebum production, helping to balance oily and dry skin. It addresses imbalances that can cause acne, clogged pores, and dryness by reducing shine and preventing excess oil, especially in breakout-prone areas. At the same time, it maintains the necessary moisture balance to avoid irritation and dryness, making it ideal for combination or oily skin. In addition to normalizing sebum levels, this formula protects the skin’s natural barrier, keeping it resilient against environmental stressors. With regular use, it promotes a clearer, smoother, and more even complexion without tightness or dryness, offering a gentle yet effective solution for healthier, balanced skin.

products.description: This hydrating face cream, enriched with PDRN, patented hyaluronic acid, glycogen, ceramides, and gamma tocopherol, leaves the skin feeling moisturized and firm. Ceramides offer hydration, diminish the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines, and enhance skin texture. Gamma tocopherol, a unique form of vitamin E, provides antioxidant benefits.

products.title: C-Glow Serum
products.description: This serum contains Vitamin C in the form of 3-ethyl ascorbic acid, a stable and gentle variant that provides powerful antioxidant protection. Additionally, it stimulates collagen production, improving skin elasticity and texture. The serum also offers photoprotection and aids in repairing damaged cells, contributing to a youthful, radiant glow. Its stable formula makes it suitable for sensitive skin, addressing the common instability and irritation issues associated with L-ascorbic acid.
